recalled_knowledge.item: Wilks/Cowan et al. asymptotics: one-sided discovery statistic q0, Z = sqrt(q0)
Gaussian one-sided 90% upper limit at best fit 0 equals 1.2816 sigma
Fisher information b_eff = 1/sum(g_i^2/b_i) and Cauchy-Schwarz bound b_eff <= sum b_i
LZ 2024 WIMP search (arXiv:2410.17036) found no excess, best-fit signal near zero, limit corresponding to a few events at high mass
